project_info.theme: Techcombank OneU user story at Phuc Long
project_info.color_palette: Bold red, white, black, cafe brown, Phuc Long green

main_subject.detail: A user-generated style poster framed like a large printed snapshot on a red background. Inside the photo, a smiling young woman in black clothing stands inside a Phuc Long cafe and extends two long white pastry sleeves toward the camera, both printed with large green vertical text 'PHUC LONG'. The top-right header says 'TECHCOMBANK OneU'. Below the photo is a story caption in Vietnamese: 'Thay vi an 1 chiec banh mi to cua Phuc Long moi sang, minh quyet dinh chi an 2 chiec banh mi que nho xiu vua phu hop voi muc tieu giam can, vua du hoa don tren 35K de nhan them qua khi quet QR cua hang Techcombank.' Red U-point coins float around the layout and a badge says 'Da tang uu dai LOI ICH TOI UU'. A hand-drawn black arrow points toward the caption area.
main_subject.style: Casual social-proof poster mixing real cafe photography, scrapbook framing, floating reward tokens, and anecdotal caption typography
